summary: Braskem S.A. furnished a routine Form 6-K reporting its monthly treasury-share position under Article 11 of CVM Resolution 44/2021 (the Brazilian equivalent of an issuer's own-share disclosure). As of 10/30/2026 the company held 27 Class A preferred shares in treasury, with no securities or derivative transactions executed during the month and no change to the closing balance. No corporate transaction, board recommendation, advisor, price, or ownership change is disclosed. What to watch: nothing actionable; this is ordinary housekeeping disclosure, not a special situation.
